component.name: InstantDj
component.summary: DJ app for parties and events

description.p: InstantDj is a DJ application for parties, events and mobile DJs. Preview, play, and control your music on the go like a DJ — professional sound and precise transitions.

InstantDj was developed by a dedicated ballroom DJ, dancer, and software developer with the goal of creating a user-friendly DJ app — without the complexity and cost of professional DJ software, but with significantly more features than a simple music or streaming player. At the heart of the app is professional audio processing with equalization, tempo adjustment, compressor, limiter, intro/outro silence detection, and a wide range of effects — for a powerful, balanced sound that sounds equally good from one song to the next.

ul.li: Extensive sound and effect processing — can be saved individually for each song
Two separate audio outputs: the main output for the audience, and the headphone output for cueing
Fully automatic playback with intro/outro silence detection and precise crossfades
Dynamic normalizer for consistently even volume and compressor for controlled sound
Real-time waveform, spectrum, and BPM display
Integrated song browser with search, sorting by BPM, rating, recently played, and more
Smartphone remote control with switchable live audio stream
Ratings, genres/dances and categories for organizing your music collection
Save, load, and automatically back up playlists with specific settings for each song
Support for all common and high-quality audio formats

description.p: This app is designed for an audience that wants to dance or listen to music as close to the original as possible, with each track remaining clearly separated. Live remixing with beatmatching has deliberately been omitted. The app works completely locally: no uploads, no sign-in, no tracking, no account.
